I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could already see it. Marrow Fieldworks moved from her to Tobias in January, so I suggested she check with him for the latest status before the customer call.
